segments.sn22.29:1.2: “Yo, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ abhinandati, dukkhaṃ so abhinandati.
segments.sn22.29:1.3: Yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati, aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
segments.sn22.29:1.4: Yo vedanaṃ abhinandati … yo saññaṃ abhinandati … yo saṅkhāre abhinandati … yo viññāṇaṃ abhinandati, dukkhaṃ so abhinandati.
segments.sn22.29:1.8: Yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati, aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
segments.sn22.29:1.9: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ nābhinandati, dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati.
segments.sn22.29:1.10: Yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati, parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
segments.sn22.29:1.11: Yo vedanaṃ nābhinandati … yo saññaṃ nābhinandati … yo saṅkhāre nābhinandati … yo viññāṇaṃ nābhinandati, dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati.
segments.sn22.29:1.15: Yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati, parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmī”ti.
